description:
Genes in a region of one of the extra Brassica assemblies (32 Brassica assemblies distributed by BnaOmics: B. napus Darmor-bzh v10, Express 617, NY7, the eight HZAU genomes (Gangan, Zheyou 73, Shengli, Tapidor, Quinta, Westar, No2127; ZS11 is the BnIR genome) and the HZAU pan-genome reference, ZS11, Westar and Laurentian ONT assemblies, ZS4-2, ZS9, HTR001, Zhongyou 821 and ZS11 (FAFU); B. carinata zd-1; B. juncea AU213 and tumida v2; B. nigra YZ12151, Ni100 v2, C2; B. oleracea HDEM, JZS v2, Korso, OX-heart; B. rapa Chiifu v3.0 and v2.5, Z1 v2 (assembly ids like Bnapus_Darmor_v10, Bnapus_Westar_ONT, Brapa_Chiifu_v3; B. napus genes are matched to Ensembl Darmor v4.1, B. rapa to Chiifu, B. oleracea to TO1000, B. juncea and B. nigra to Ensembl B. juncea, B. carinata to B. juncea + B. oleracea)) with their best Ensembl Plants match,
e.g. to list candidates under a QTL or SV mapped on that assembly. assembly: assembly id; chrom as named in that
assembly; at most 2 Mb.
name: assembly_genes_in_region
